title: Paradise X #12 Marvel Comics August 2003 Alex Ross Final Issue Krueger
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Paradise X #12 (August 2003), Marvel Comics - the final issue of the Earth X / Universe X / Paradise X trilogy. Story by Jim Krueger with Alex Ross, art by Dougie Braithwaite and Bill Reinhold, painted Alex Ross cover. Direct edition, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: X2 Wolverine's Revenge video game ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
